name: all_ads_extreme
description: 15 items, 15 ads (100%) on Facebook - extreme rate, strong prior shrinkage
notes: 100% observed ads is implausible. Prior strongly pulls estimate down to ~51%. Note: Bayesian CI is WIDER here because it's centered away from the boundary. This is appropriate - the prior expresses skepticism about extreme rates. The interval_width_reduction is negative because Bayesian is wider, which correctly reflects uncertainty about the true rate.
